svg.title: An assignee is always somebody on the team — SoftTrack web design mockup (#316)
svg.desc: Creating a ticket and editing one refuse an assignee who is not a member of the team, with the code the bulk edit already gives. The picker lists members and shows guests as read-only. Removing a member who holds open tickets asks whether to unassign them or hand them over.
svg.text: An assignee is always somebody on the team
· one check on every path, and a question when a member leaves
The picker offers members, and says why a guest is not one of them
